samples.question: Inside the single blue-framed square tile, reflect the tile across its vertical centerline and take the absolute pixel-by-pixel difference between the tile and its reflection. The tile interior is an 8-row by 12-column raster; average each left/right mirrored cell pair into an 8-row by 6-column grid. Mark # when a cell's mean RGB difference is at least 30, and . otherwise. Read rows top-to-bottom and compare with A. Which symbol appears? Ignore the frame and everything outside the tile. Answer A or B.
